snippet.title: LAPD 2195  - World Premiere Reveal Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Made by a solo developer this is a modern Multiplayer and Co-Op re-imagining of the classic game "Future Cop L.A.P.D.” from the original PlayStation era, you are a rookie cop in the Mech-Assisted Security and Tactics (M.A.S.T.) unit of the Los Angeles Police Department in the year 2195.
